summary: Bound bank verification to 60 seconds and reconcile stale bank-action payments deterministically without another financial submission.
reason: A real Topnet acceptance reached the original issuer 3DS2 form and SMS stage. After the owner cancelled the issuer screen, the canonical PaymentRecord stayed requires_bank_action indefinitely because no bank-return callback was observed. Amine requested a 60-second no-response transition to cancelled.

tests.name: payment-core
tests.evidence: 54/54 Payment Core cases passed, including 60-second threshold, unpaid cancellation, read-only ambiguity reconciliation and bank-return race.

capabilities.reason: Canonical capability truth is updated in ui-playbooks; this repository implements that contract.

architecture.reason: Reuses the existing Companion process, PaymentRecord store, adapter quote/readback and resume path. No scheduler, daemon, ledger or second transaction owner is added.

rollback: Revert this scoped runtime commit and reactivate the previous Companion while preserving existing no-replay guards and payment records.
limitations: A 60-second timeout becomes cancelled only after a fresh provider quote proves the same invoice is still unpaid.
If provider state is no longer definitely unpaid, the existing read-only resume path is used; unresolved evidence remains effect_unknown.
No timeout path sends a second FORM1.
